name: virustotal-monitor-action
description: GitHub Action that uploads release artifacts to VirusTotal Monitor and prunes old ones to stay under the storage quota

scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke

//overrides: @actions/core 3.x and @actions/glob 0.7 are ESM-only; ncc bundles this action as CJS and
silently emits a bundle with @actions/core stubbed out. So we stay on the CJS 1.x line and
force its transitive undici up to a patched release instead -- @actions/http-client pins
undici ^5, and everything <=6.26.0 carries the smuggling/poisoning advisories.
brace-expansion: jest's minimatch chain pulls 1.x, and the only fixed release is 5.0.8+.
